Leo and Owen are in the same class. Leo wants to visit Toronto. I am happy every day. In fact, shall we go for a picnic on Sunday?
After school, we play together. Owen likes salad too. The green hill is big and clean. Also, the car needs more petrol.
We often go to the bookstore together. Leo goes to the bookstore on Friday. The bird-watching spot is my favorite place.
